aggregated_statement_text: If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), Alliance political consensus for a counteroffensive fractures, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), Alliance political consensus for a counteroffensive fractures, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), Alliance political consensus for a counteroffensive fractures, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), reception and onward movement through Poland slips past C+7, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), reception and onward movement through Poland slips past C+7, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), reception and onward movement through Poland slips past C+7, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), a strike on a reception node halts onward movement, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Low risk to preservation of the force in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), a strike on a reception node halts onward movement, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Low risk to preservation of the force in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), a strike on a reception node halts onward movement, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Low risk to preservation of the force in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), the armored division fails to close two brigade combat teams by C+21, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), the armored division fails to close two brigade combat teams by C+21, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), the armored division fails to close two brigade combat teams by C+21, then the Joint Force's ability to protect force closure and D-Day on time may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to force closure and D-Day on time in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), every Baltic sea port of debarkation is closed by mining or strike, then the Joint Force's ability to protect operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits may be degraded resulting in Low risk to operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), every Baltic sea port of debarkation is closed by mining or strike, then the Joint Force's ability to protect operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits may be degraded resulting in Low risk to operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), every Baltic sea port of debarkation is closed by mining or strike, then the Joint Force's ability to protect operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits may be degraded resulting in Low risk to operation conducted inside force and sustainment limits in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), Russia conducts a demonstrative nuclear detonation, then the Joint Force's ability to protect escalation contained below the nuclear threshold may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to escalation contained below the nuclear threshold in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), Russia conducts a demonstrative nuclear detonation, then the Joint Force's ability to protect escalation contained below the nuclear threshold may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to escalation contained below the nuclear threshold in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), Russia conducts a demonstrative nuclear detonation, then the Joint Force's ability to protect escalation contained below the nuclear threshold may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to escalation contained below the nuclear threshold in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), the Suwalki corridor is closed to Allied ground movement, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), the Suwalki corridor is closed to Allied ground movement, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), the Suwalki corridor is closed to Allied ground movement, then the Joint Force's ability to protect restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity may be degraded resulting in Moderate risk to restoration of Estonian and Latvian territorial integrity in the long-term (5-15 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the near-term (0-3 years), the mission partner network fails to carry Allied command and control, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Low risk to preservation of the force in the near-term (0-3 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the mid-term (2-7 years), the mission partner network fails to carry Allied command and control, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Low risk to preservation of the force in the mid-term (2-7 years).

If the following related harmful events or conditions occur in combination within the long-term (5-15 years), the mission partner network fails to carry Allied command and control, then the Joint Force's ability to protect preservation of the force may be degraded resulting in Low risk to preservation of the force in the long-term (5-15 years).
